summary: Accepted as a fresh, bounded existing baseline/heading native replay after original-fixture recovery. Independently rehashed checkpoint and fork closures, receipt/source/config/executable bindings, recomputed request/variant identities and polyline lengths. Heading delta is +37 px and +1 recorded bend; all six native outcomes remain unknown/petered-out with no basket assignment. This is technical replay evidence, not new route capability, geometry acceptance or cache-root proof.
interpretiveNotes: W2 comparison.endpointArrival=false means no arrival event was reported; actual arrival validity remains UNKNOWN, matching W2 verdictScope. Prefer endpointArrivalObserved:false in future adapters.
Native unknown traces omit basketId; W2 null is an absence normalization. A row id naming basket-10 is an unowned geometry hint, not assigned basket ownership.

Both field support/theta hashes and complete summaries match across native baseline and heading, and both receipts record baselineExact:true. Those hashes are native testimony bound to source/code, not an independently regenerated field-array check.
The first ENOENT is an executable fixture-availability failure before CV, preserved as technical failure evidence; it cannot falsify a route hypothesis.

The original JPEG is the only checkpoint-file difference from the pinned repository, restored byte-for-byte from the stated active-reference Git blob. Target scripts/config/declarations are unchanged.
limitations: No full CV replay performed in review. Field arrays are not persisted by legacy receipt; cross-receipt support/theta hashes and summaries were compared, not regenerated from raw arrays.
Canonical RGBA SHA is matching receipt/capture metadata; this review independently hashed JPEG bytes but did not decode/crop pixels.
Legacy probe does not emit cache root key or a transitive compiled-code identity; current checkpoint closure was separately rehashed.
No basketId property is emitted on unknown native traced results; W2 summary null is a normalization of absence, not a successful null-valued ownership test.
nextEligible: Use current unknown replay as the input to a separately preregistered negative-case falsifier, including badge exit and crossing ambiguity.
A longer trace alone cannot authorize retain; require current independent protocol validation plus separate explicit scoped Sam acceptance.
Treat initial worker-state acknowledgement gap as historical: root states the initial six starts were acknowledged before PASS1 finish and PASS2 starts are acknowledged immediately.
